note: Official actions by incumbents on items that name one of their campaign donors, or that a registered lobbyist worked on, checked by hand against meeting minutes or roll calls. Each action lists the candidate's own role and every vote. Donations are from the candidate's official campaign reports. Dates are shown as recorded: giving before or after an action is listed, not judged. Edit by hand; keep only verified items. role: yes | no | absent | moved | seconded | presented. votes.consent = approved as part of the consent agenda. officeholders: who holds (or held) a seat on the body the race is for, checked Oct 13, 2026 against city and county sites and news; reviewed = their official actions were checked for this list. checked: races where every candidate's status was checked; a candidate there who is not listed holds no seat on that body now. reason: nodata = no itemized campaign reports posted, so donors cannot be checked; nogivers = reports list no outside donors; nominutes = the body posts agendas but not minutes, so votes cannot be verified. State legislators (Florida House and Senate): kind = request (a budget project request the legislator filed; result says so; role requested) or bill (a bill they filed; role sponsor). result overrides passed/failed in the display. Donors include gifts to a political committee the legislator chairs, labeled in the name. For requests, the donor is the recipient named on the request form or the lobbying firm (or its PAC or lobbyists) named as registered lobbyist. Generated from FL DOE contributions and House APR / Senate LFIR forms; see claude/state-votes-vs-donors.md in the project. lobbied: registered lobbyists on the item, from the body's own lobbyist registry (src = key in registries; 'form' = the state request form at url). name, firm, for (the client as written in the registry), reg (registration date as recorded; YYYY-MM when the registry gives only month and year). An action may have lobbied and no donors: that means no gift from the client, its lobbyists or their firms appears in the candidate's reports. role sponsoredItem = put the item on the agenda.

context.en: The mayor pulled it from the consent agenda and moved to raise the amount by 10% and widen the scope (7-0). Chernoff then moved final approval. The firm was hired from the city's pool of pre-qualified lobbying firms. Chernoff's report also counts a $1,000 in-kind gift that it does not name.
context.es: El alcalde lo sacó de la agenda de consentimiento y propuso aumentar el monto en un 10% y ampliar el alcance (7-0). Luego Chernoff propuso la aprobación final. La firma fue contratada de la lista de cabilderos precalificados de la ciudad. El reporte de Chernoff también cuenta un aporte en especie de $1,000 sin nombre.
context.ht: Majistra a te retire l nan ajanda konsantman an epi li te pwopoze ogmante kantite lajan an 10% ak elaji travay la (7-0). Apre sa Chernoff te pwopoze apwobasyon final la. Yo te chwazi biwo a nan lis lobiyis vil la te deja kalifye. Rapò Chernoff la konte tou yon don $1,000 an nati li pa nonmen.

title.en: Accepted a right-of-way agreement with conditions from Florida Wood Recycling for the NW 89 Avenue road project (Resolution C-2251)
title.es: Aceptó un acuerdo de derecho de paso con condiciones de Florida Wood Recycling para el proyecto vial de la NW 89 Avenue (Resolución C-2251)
title.ht: Aksepte yon akò dwa pasaj ak kondisyon Florida Wood Recycling pou pwojè wout NW 89 Avenue (Rezolisyon C-2251)

context.en: Florida Wood gave the town the road land it needed, with conditions: the town provides a survey and a turning radius for the company's trucks, and the company keeps using part of the right-of-way for its operations. Town staff called the deal better for the town than buying the land. Ayala moved it and Lizelh Rodriguez seconded. The gifts came a year after the vote; Florida Wood also gave $250 to challenger Gloria Hernandez.
context.es: Florida Wood cedió al municipio el terreno que necesitaba para la vía, con condiciones: el municipio entrega un levantamiento topográfico y un radio de giro para los camiones de la empresa, y la empresa sigue usando parte del derecho de paso para sus operaciones. El personal municipal dijo que el acuerdo era mejor para el municipio que comprar el terreno. Ayala lo propuso y Lizelh Rodriguez lo secundó. Los aportes llegaron un año después de la votación; Florida Wood también dio $250 a la candidata Gloria Hernandez.
context.ht: Florida Wood te bay vil la tè li te bezwen pou wout la, ak kondisyon: vil la bay yon apantaj ak yon espas pou kamyon konpayi a vire, epi konpayi a kontinye sèvi ak yon pati nan dwa pasaj la pou operasyon li. Anplwaye vil la te di akò a pi bon pou vil la pase achte tè a. Ayala te pwopoze l epi Lizelh Rodriguez te apiye l. Don yo te rive yon ane apre vòt la; Florida Wood te bay kandida Gloria Hernandez $250 tou.

title.en: Appointed Michael McDearmaid, the mayor's pick, to the Centennial Committee (Resolution 2025-R-205)
title.es: Nombró a Michael McDearmaid, elegido por el alcalde, al Comité del Centenario (Resolución 2025-R-205)
title.ht: Nonmen Michael McDearmaid, moun majistra a te chwazi, nan Komite Santenè a (Rezolisyon 2025-R-205)

context.en: Each member picks one Centennial Committee member; the resolution says Mayor Desulme chose McDearmaid, though he was absent for the vote. McDearmaid is vice chair of the city's Planning Commission. The donor is McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; that it is his firm is inferred from the name, not confirmed. In September 2026 the council also took up naming a street for him; that vote's record is not posted yet.
context.es: Cada miembro elige a un integrante del Comité del Centenario; la resolución dice que el alcalde Desulme eligió a McDearmaid, aunque estuvo ausente en la votación. McDearmaid es vicepresidente de la Comisión de Planificación de la ciudad. El donante es McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; que sea su firma se deduce del nombre, no está confirmado. En septiembre de 2026 el concejo también consideró nombrar una calle en su honor; el registro de esa votación aún no se publica.
context.ht: Chak manm chwazi yon moun pou Komite Santenè a; rezolisyon an di se majistra Desulme ki te chwazi McDearmaid, menmsi li te absan pou vòt la. McDearmaid se vis-prezidan Komisyon Planifikasyon vil la. Donatè a se McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; nou dedui se konpayi pa l la nan non an, sa pa konfime. An septanm 2026 konsèy la te pran yon dosye tou pou bay yon lari non l; dosye vòt sa a poko pibliye.

context.en: House budget request forms (2025 session and 2026 session) name Avery R. Mazur, Sydney P. Ridley of The Southern Group as the registered lobbyist. Requests: Manatee Rescue, Rehabilitation, and Release at Zoo Miami, $1.1 million (Zoo Miami Foundation, form 1637) [2026; in final budget, $550,000]; Sweetwater Stormwater Infrastructure and Improvement, $952,000 (City of Sweetwater, form 1656) [2026; in final budget, $476,000]; University of Florida - Hamilton Center for Classical and Civic Education, $1.8 million (University of Florida, form 1670) [2026; in final budget, $1.8 million]; University of Florida - Advanced Brain Research and Innovation, $25 million (University of Florida, form 2651) [2026; in final budget, $20 million]; Zoo Miami Manatee Rescue/Rehabilitation/Release, $1.1 million (Zoo Miami Foundation, form 1453) [2025; in final budget, $1.7 million]; University of Florida - AI Leadership Technology Renewal (HiPerGator), $24 million (University of Florida, form 1454) [2025; in final budget, $350,000]; University of Florida - Hamilton Center for Classical and Civic Education, $13 million (University of Florida, form 1471) [2025; in final budget, $8 million]. Requests were filed Feb. 6, 2025 to Nov. 21, 2025. Budget status is from the final budgets the Legislature passed (SB 2500 for 2025-26, HB 5001E for 2026-27) and the governor’s veto lists.

Se presentaron entre el 6 de febrero de 2025 y el 21 de noviembre de 2025. El estado en el presupuesto viene de los presupuestos finales aprobados por la Legislatura (SB 2500 para 2025-26, HB 5001E para 2026-27) y de las listas de vetos del gobernador.

context.en: House budget request form 1667 (2026 session, filed Nov. 18, 2025), “Math Success Innovation Pilot,” names Prisms of Reality Inc., a for-profit company that makes the PrismsVR virtual-reality math program, as the entity receiving the funds, and Sheela VanHoose of The Southern Group as the registered lobbyist. The Southern Group’s PAC gave his committee $27,500 in 2025 and 2026; those gifts are listed with his other requests lobbied by The Southern Group. It was in the final 2026-27 budget (HB 5001E) at $800,000, and the governor vetoed it. context.es: El formulario de solicitud de fondos 1667 de la Cámara (sesión de 2026, presentado el 18 de noviembre de 2025), “Math Success Innovation Pilot”, nombra a Prisms of Reality Inc., una empresa con fines de lucro que hace el programa de matemáticas en realidad virtual PrismsVR, como la entidad que recibiría los fondos, y a Sheela VanHoose de The Southern Group como cabildera registrada. Prisms dio $10,000 a su comité político un mes después de presentada la solicitud. El PAC de The Southern Group dio $27,500 a su comité en 2025 y 2026; esos aportes aparecen con sus otras solicitudes cabildeadas por The Southern Group. Quedó en el presupuesto final 2026-27 (HB 5001E) por $800,000, y el gobernador la vetó. context.ht: Fòm demann lajan 1667 Lachanm nan (sesyon 2026, depoze 18 novanm 2025), “Math Success Innovation Pilot”, nonmen Prisms of Reality Inc., yon konpayi pou fè pwofi ki fè pwogram matematik reyalite vityèl PrismsVR, kòm antite ki ta resevwa lajan an, ak Sheela VanHoose nan The Southern Group kòm lobiyis anrejistre. Prisms te bay komite politik li a $10,000 yon mwa apre yo te depoze demann lan. PAC The Southern Group te bay komite li a $27,500 an 2025 ak 2026; don sa yo parèt ak lòt demann li yo The Southern Group te fè lobi pou yo. Li te nan bidjè final 2026-27 la (HB 5001E) pou $800,000, epi gouvènè a mete veto sou li. context.en: HB 1389, filed Jan. 9, 2026, let Live Local Act projects go on qualifying religious land and on land owned by a local government or school district, limited local height and setback rules, narrowed when a local government can opt out, and let affordable-housing developers sue under the Florida Fair Housing Act. It passed the House 98-4 and the Senate 35-0 and was signed June 29, 2026. The donors listed are developers of affordable housing and their committee; this list does not claim they asked for the bill.
context.es: El HB 1389, presentado el 9 de enero de 2026, permitió proyectos de la Ley Live Local en terrenos religiosos que califican y en terrenos de un gobierno local o distrito escolar, limitó las normas locales de altura y retiro, restringió cuándo un gobierno local puede excluirse y permitió a los desarrolladores de vivienda asequible demandar bajo la Ley de Vivienda Justa de Florida. Fue aprobado 98-4 en la Cámara y 35-0 en el Senado y se firmó el 29 de junio de 2026. Los donantes listados son desarrolladores de vivienda asequible y su comité; esta lista no afirma que ellos pidieran el proyecto.
context.ht: HB 1389, depoze 9 janvye 2026, te pèmèt pwojè lwa Live Local sou tè relijye ki kalifye ak sou tè yon gouvènman lokal oswa distri lekòl posede, te limite règ lokal sou wotè ak distans, te diminye lè yon gouvènman lokal ka retire kò l, epi te pèmèt devlopè lojman abòdab fè pwosè anba Lwa Lojman Jis Florid la. Li te pase 98-4 nan Lachanm ak 35-0 nan Sena a epi yo te siyen l 29 jen 2026. Donatè ki nan lis la se devlopè lojman abòdab ak komite yo; lis sa a pa di se yo ki te mande pwojè a.

context.en: The House staff analysis of HB 429 says: “The bill may have a positive economic impact on franchised motor vehicle dealers in the state.” His vote: yes (April 23, 2025). The donors listed are franchised car dealerships in Florida and their political committee, as their names and occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for his vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2025-38).
context.es: El análisis legislativo de HB 429 dice (en inglés; traducción): “El proyecto puede tener un impacto económico positivo para los concesionarios de vehículos con franquicia en el estado.” Su voto: sí (23 de abril de 2025). Los donantes que aparecen son concesionarios de autos con franquicia en Florida y su comité político, según sus nombres y ocupaciones en los reportes de campaña; esto no afirma que pidieran el proyecto ni su voto. Las donaciones se muestran con las fechas registradas, incluso las posteriores al voto. El proyecto se convirtió en ley (Ch. 2025-38).
context.ht: Analiz Lejislati a sou HB 429 di (an angle; tradiksyon): “Pwojè lwa a ka gen yon efè ekonomik pozitif pou konsesyonè machin ki gen franchiz nan eta a.” Vòt li: wi (23 avril 2025). Donatè ki parèt yo se konsesyonè machin ki gen franchiz nan Florid ak komite politik yo, jan non yo ak travay yo parèt nan rapò finansman kanpay yo; sa pa di yo te mande pwojè lwa a ni vòt li. Kado yo parèt ak dat yo anrejistre, menm sa ki vini apre vòt la. Pwojè a te tounen lwa (Ch. 2025-38).

context.ht: Analiz Lejislati a sou HB 1137 di (an angle; tradiksyon): “Pwojè lwa a pèmèt distribitè bwason ki gen alkòl dedui nan taks espesyal sou bwason sa yo pèt nòmal pwodwi, tankou pèt akòz kase, gate, evapore oswa ekspire.” Vòt li: wi (26 fevriye 2026). context.ht: Analiz Lejislati a sou HB 1525 di (an angle; tradiksyon): “Pwojè lwa a ka gen yon efè pozitif ki pa detèmine sou sektè prive a paske li egzante konpayi transpò pa aplikasyon (TNC) anba sèten egzijans sou enspeksyon sekirite ak fòmasyon chofè.” Se li ki te depoze vèsyon Sena a, SB 1696. Vòt li: wi (23 avril 2025). Donatè ki parèt yo se konpayi transpò pa aplikasyon, jan non yo ak travay yo parèt nan rapò finansman kanpay yo; sa pa di yo te mande pwojè lwa a ni vòt li. Kado yo parèt ak dat yo anrejistre, menm sa ki vini apre vòt la. Pwojè a te tounen lwa (Ch. 2025-66).
